notes.title: Full Release
notes.notes:
Avenging Angel has now been fully released. 

Thank you each and every one of you who have supported us throughout the years. 

We are painfully aware that this took a lot longer than we anticipated, but we have essentially redone the entire game. That means all graphical assets, animations, foley, and music. Everything. We brought in a lot of new features such as status effects, a lot more varied weapons, new enemies, and new areas.

We sincerely hope you enjoy the game.

notes.title: (Finnish) Independence Day Update
notes.notes:
Today is the Finnish Independence Day, which pretty much means that the entire country is shut down for the festivities. 

Anyhoo, we have posted some new content on Avenging Angel Facebook today. The biggest thing in that particular in-game content is that certain crafting recipes can  be unlocked by "reading" posters and adds. Enemy weak spots can be also scoped from reading "R&D"-documentation. 

Have a looksie https://www.facebook.com/avengingangelgame/

notes.title: Big Update coming
notes.notes:
Greetings, each and all! 

Avenging Angel will receive a big update on the last week of August 2015. 

- a ton of bug fixes
- controller support completely redone 
- better performance
- graphics update (the entire statue forest scene, which has caused performance issues and fps drops, will be completely redone)
- new save system
- new enemies
- new areas
- new NPCs
- new collectables (alchemy ingredients and power-ups)
- new weapons, both ranged and melee (rapid fire flintlocks, shotgun, katana & GunBlade among others)
- fast travel system between certain areas
- new music and background ambient system

AND

- introducing the Avenging Angel ARENA 

Keep your eye on https://www.facebook.com/avengingangelgame and https://twitter.com/avengingangel02 for screenshots and videos in the coming weeks

notes.title: Next Patch June 15th
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Based on the feedback and bug reporting, we will be patching the game on Monday June 15th. 

Besides the normal bug crushing and optimisation for better performance, here is what is new:

- The Statue Forest area performance should be better. Some folks have experienced the game crashing between "Outpost" and "Statue Forest" (1st and 2nd area). The forest area is really, really big and we attempt to solve the issue by queuing assets differently and we are looking into memory allocation as well. 

- The Hangar autosave point has been re-adjusted and death trigger at the Hangar has been removed.

- Controller support should be better. DS4 should work with USB and Bluetooth. After the update, we will also post a screenshot of DS4 settings we know will work. 

Thank you all for playing, your support, criticism, and feedback. 

We see you all and we hear you all.

-Dark Amber Crew

notes.title: Game update today (Monday June 8th)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. A new update to the game just went live! Here's what's new:

Player Character controls are re-defined. Those of you who experienced trouble with DS4, this update should fix that. Unfortunately 360 controller does not work in menus, but gameplay should be now good.

Statue Forest area has been optimised and should run now smoother.

Enemy stats regarding "Arnold" 1881-A1 have now been re-adjusted. The direct fire from the gatling gun will still hurt, but the robot should bite the dust a bit easier. Fear not, it still a challenge.

Grenade launcher ammo now stays in the inventory. 

"Recipe disappearance bug" in workshop now fixxored.
